value.title: Move pij's PRD register into docs/project as PRD 002
value.summary: Roadmap 001 step s14, req-25. pij's requirements register becomes docs/project/prds/002-pij-base.dd.json under the pij/prd schema, and the old location gets a pointer. Draft: blocked on the rulings in open questions 1 to 3, because the register is not where AGENTS.md says and its source is private.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Planning found (2026-11-04): pij-fleet's government root has no prd/ folder; AGENTS.md line 18 points at <government-root>/prd/base-prd.dd.json, which does not exist here. The register is in the legacy repo AI-Substrate/pij (PRIVATE), branch prime-governance, path .harness/government/prd/base-prd.dd.json: schema prd/requirements, 54 rows (36 unchecked, 10 checked, 4 shipped, 4 open), 113 KB, last changed 2026-09-07 (e05661c8). pij-fleet is PUBLIC. Rows cite private PR numbers, machine-local paths (/Users/...), scratch files and other projects (chainglass). pij/prd requires priority and done_when on every row; the source has neither. PRD number 002 is claimed for this plan by pm-001.

sections.name: goals
value: pij's requirements live in docs/project/prds/ beside PRD 001, under the same schema.
No requirement, state or receipt is lost in the move.
Nothing private reaches the public repo.
Everything that pointed at the old path points at the new one.

sections.name: non_goals
value: Re-deciding any requirement. Rows move as they are; amendments come later, through the PRD procedure (s13).
Editing the legacy repo. Its prime commits the retirement pointer there.

value.claim: Frozen source. The source commit sha is recorded, and the legacy register's writer is told it is frozen before conversion starts.

Faithful conversion. Every source row becomes a pij/prd requirement with the same id and title; statement comes from the source requirement; state follows the mapping ruled in open question 2; done_when and priority follow open question 3; receipts (completed_evidence) move to delivered_by and note. The source meta's rules (single writer, receipt rule, register discipline) become the why and a changelog row. Row count in equals row count out, checked by script. PRD 002 validates clean.

Publication. PRD 002 holds no machine paths, credentials, private transcript text or other projects' names, and private PR references follow open question 1. The security verdict passes on the exact head.

Pointers. AGENTS.md's Governance section and skills/pij/references/prime/rituals/bootstrap.md point at docs/project/prds/002-pij-base.dd.json. The legacy register gets a one-line pointer, committed by its prime.
States. In this PR: roadmap s14 goes to shipped with its plan cell set to docs/plans/192-prd-register-move; req-25 goes to shipped. PRD 001 and roadmap 001 validate clean.

value.title: Convert, scrub and publish the register
value.brief: AC1 to AC5. docs-system seat, after s13 and after the rulings. CS-3: 54 rows, and done_when has to be written for most of them.

value.question: Ruling: may the register, scrubbed, be published in public pij-fleet? Options: (a) move all 54 rows, scrubbed; private PR numbers become 'AI-Substrate/pij#N (private)' or are dropped to the sha; (b) move only rows still open (40), with a note that shipped history stays in the private repo; (c) do not move it; amend req-25 to drop. Recommended: (a). Needs Jordan.
State mapping into planned, in-progress, shipped, dropped. Recommended: checked and shipped to shipped; unchecked and open to planned, or in-progress where the row's note names live work.

done_when and priority for rows that lack them. Recommended: shipped rows use their receipt rule as done_when; other rows get the requirement's own testable clause, or 'to be written' in note; priority 'should' unless the row says must.

value.risk: Private content published in a public repo.
value.mitigation: Ruling first (open question 1), scrub script, security verdict on the exact head.

value.risk: Writing done_when for 50 rows turns the move into a rewrite.
value.mitigation: Open question 3: derive from receipts for shipped rows; a placeholder rule for the rest, flagged in note.

value.risk: The legacy register keeps being edited during the move.

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: Read the source only from git by sha; never copy scratch/ or .harness/temp/ files it cites.
Do not start until the rulings in open questions 1 to 3 are recorded in assets/rulings.md.
